review: Reviewed Sol's round-21 request (Build a small branch windbreak: learn a feasible method for a stable, modest, open-woven branch windbreak beside an outdoor resting place, with unknown materials and costs, avoiding people and living trees) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 4): a general branch-screen construction operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle for an unroofed, about 0.9 m wide, 0.40-0.45 m high porous woven screen from three uprights and eight flexible rods, reusing base gather for acquisition, with deterministic suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, wind effects only on a measured small leeward footprint from current wind, height, porosity and integrity, or else an unverified screen, and no shelter, roof, rain, warmth, comfort or reward bonus. The specification is self-consistent and every dependency exists or could be bounded here, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented branch-screen@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 4; the ability serializes to 3,453 code units). Assess (x, y, orientation; the screen line within reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy, probe-compatible observation) checks a 1.2 x 0.6 m footprint centred on the line (inside the world, ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, overlapping no plant, object, site, entrance or person) and the 0.9 x 0.9 m lee floor (inside the world, not water, no solid object or site), and reports current wind and rain, the facing for the orientation, the 11-unit recipe and the person's usable branch units (branch-screen-assessed, unverified personal record). Assess with post (an owned, unreserved whole branch unit; 1 round, 0.5 energy) is the physical support trial at x, y: on ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard and branch strength at least 0.3 the post goes 0.25 m in by hand and holds, and stays owned and unchanged; elsewhere the trial records the measured refusal; a post below condition 0.5 breaks and one unit becomes an owned damaged stack with its mass kept (branch-screen-trial, unverified record); no support or structure is made and the probe sample is untouched. Assemble (x, y, orientation, materials: exactly 11 owned untreated or sound recovered whole branch units) requires mastery, the person's own passing trial inside the footprint, a passing site check and 1.5 energy; it reserves the units through collective-work escrow with exact source provenance (still carried, owned and ageing; branch-screen-started), creates the screen object as a non-solid planned line, and pays 8 rounds of 1.5 energy (12 energy): two seating the uprights at -0.45, 0 and +0.45 m along the line (0.25 m insertion), four weaving two rods each, one gap/alignment round and one stability check, each moving the escrowed units into the screen with origin, mass and age (branch-screen-progress). The check (upright seating: all three uprights at condition at least 0.5 in ordinary soil, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, branch strength at least 0.3; weave retention: all eight rods at condition at least 0.5 and branch flexibility at least 0.2) either completes the screen (branch-screen-completed) or leaves it unstable without shielding (branch-screen-check-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach, a saturated or hazardous footprint or a person on it pause before any charge (branch-screen-paused); assemble or repair naming the screen resumes after the rechecks (branch-screen-resumed); a lost reserved unit stops the work (branch-screen-failed). Cancel (no energy) returns uninstalled units once; death leaves them where the person died; installed pieces stay as an incomplete screen. Inspect (target in reach; 1 round, 0.2 energy) reports installed, missing and loose pieces, integrity, porosity, current wind and rain, facing, the shield the rule gives now and lee-floor occupants (branch-screen-inspected, unverified record; nothing repaired). Repair (builder only; target, components: installed piece ids, materials: the same number of units) pays one removal and one fitting round per piece and a check round at 1.5 energy each; removed pieces become unowned ground debris at their place with condition, mass and provenance; components [] only reruns the check; it needs a fully installed screen (branch-screen-repaired, then completed or check-failed). Dismantle (builder only; 1 round, 1 energy) removes up to three pieces per round, rods before uprights, to the ground with their condition, and the object disappears with the last group (branch-screen-dismantled). No energy, time or damage is refunded. Effect: through a physiology hook outermost in forestPhysiology, a complete screen removes min(0.35, solid share of its sound pieces) x facing of the wind part (exposure x wind) of the existing outdoor chill for a living person whose whole body circle lies on the lee floor, 0.45-1.35 m behind the line and within its 0.9 m width (branch-screen-exposure-measured); rain chill, air temperature, hunger, energy and rest are unchanged; nothing applies in wind above 0.8, indoors, when a roofed shelter applies or when another shelter rule already changed that round's exposure, and copies never stack. Weather wear per round on installed pieces is the reused ex11/ex15 law 0.0005 + 0.002 x rain + 0.002 x wind; a rod below 0.5 no longer counts toward the solid share (branch-screen-deteriorated), an upright below 0.5 makes a complete screen damaged with no shielding until repair and a passing check (branch-screen-damaged). Installed pieces make the thin 0.06 x 0.9 m line solid for passage. The completion event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone is awarded, records are unverified (no information-confirmed event; the existing information-gain rule is bound to probe and does not apply), and no satisfaction, comfort or reward source is added. Modeling assumptions: the world gives a fallen-branch unit no length, diameter, straightness or point, so, as in ex15 simple-shelter@1, one whole untreated branch unit (1.1 mass units) is one piece of the declared size (uprights 0.7 m x 2.5 cm, rods 1.1 m x 1.5 cm); the recipe is therefore 11 units (12.1 mass units, 22 gather energy), dimensions are declared rather than measured, and the mass per piece is larger than a real stick of that size. Hand insertion works only in ordinary soil with waterlogging at most 0.1 and no hazard (the ex15 shelter and long-planting-site hand-work rule); forest floor, wet bank, dry hard ground and water refuse it; insertion depth is the declared 0.25 m and there is no stiffness model, so no numeric displacement is computed: the low-force check counts loose pieces against condition 0.5 (the ex15 sound condition) and uses the probe-revealed branch strength (0.3, ex15's load threshold) and flexibility (0.2) values; flexibility 0.2 is taken as sufficient for a gentle open weave in which each rod deflects about one upright thickness over the 0.45 m spacing (ex15 requires 0.7 only for wrapped binding), and fit and spring-back are not represented separately; a post below condition 0.5 breaks under the push. The solid share is the projected area of the sound rods and uprights over the 0.9 x 0.4 m woven face (about 0.36, porosity about 0.64), and the wind reduction on the lee floor equals that share capped at the existing 0.35 maximum wind shield of simple-shelter@1, a first-order porous-barrier approximation; the lee floor spans one to three screen heights behind the line, beyond the 0.45 m fall reach, and only the screen's width, because a short screen gives little shelter past its ends; people are 0.22 m circles without posture, so the rule presumes a body resting low on the ground. World wind has speed but no direction: the only direction the existing exposure physics represents is the +x convention of the ex10 refuge and ex15 shelters, so orientation 0 faces it and facing is cos(orientation); wind shifts cannot occur, which the ability states. The ex15 light-weather wind limit (0.8) withholds shielding. Loose pieces stay installed rather than falling. The world has no place ownership or access permissions, so none is checked or granted. Grounded: real branch units, escrow, mass and provenance, energy and round costs, ground conditions, material values, current wind and rain, the existing exposure chill and body-temperature update, and the existing wear law. Not grounded (declared or approximated): piece dimensions, the 0.25 m insertion, the flexibility threshold, the porosity-to-shield relation, the lee floor extent, the +x wind direction, and the absence of a displacement model. Reuse: ex15 simple-shelter@1's sound condition, wear law, light-weather wind limit, largest wind shield and the staged paid-assembly, install, release, pause, cancel and death pattern (constants imported or re-declared; ex15 code unchanged and ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical); collective-work.ts escrow and paid work; material-lots.ts; open-physical.ts; forest-climate.ts; open-foundation.ts personal records; unchanged base gather and rest. New files long-branch-screen.ts and long-branch-screen-exposure.ts; the hook is added in forest-environment.ts and returns the incoming value unless branch-screen@1 is installed; a small branch-screen drawing is added to continuous-visuals.ts (dashed plan line, installed uprights and woven rods only, grey when loose, no shielding drawn) because the ex15 lean-to drawing assumes a roof. Tests cover scope, learning, the size limit and excluded vocabulary, assessment and post-trial costs and outcomes (including an informative failure and breakage), cost-free refusals (no trial, wrong recipe, out of reach, occupied footprint, low energy, wet bank), the 8 paid rounds and 12 energy, conservation and carried load, the drawing, wind-only shielding with the exact temperature change, facing, lee-floor bounds and the wind limit, pause and resume, cancel, builder-only repair and dismantle, inspection, wear to a loose rod and a loose upright, exact repair, a failed check and its rerun, dismantling in groups of three and death.
